points.rewrite: Rewrote the Performance Appraisal system from native PHP to Laravel 12 on MySQL for 200+ employees.
points.sync: Replaced a manual 2 to 3 day quarterly entry step with an HRIS sync and bulk Excel import, saving 8 to 12 working days a year.
points.dashboard: Built the appraisal period screens, dashboards and Excel/PDF export, then trained the admins who run the cycle.

points.interface: Shipped the interface for an AI video summarisation and content tool in Next.js and TypeScript.
points.library: Put the shared Radix components under Storybook with Jest tests, so a change to a primitive was verified before it reached a page.
points.pipeline: Built a video summarisation pipeline: it follows a YouTube channel by ID, reads each new video's auto-captions, and calls the OpenAI API for a summary and keywords.
points.schedule: Scheduled a Vercel cron at 01:00 that pulls new videos into Postgres through Prisma and skips any video with no captions.

points.interface: Built a Moodle-style LMS in Laravel 12 to test four cache strategies behind one interface, switched by one env value.
points.domain: Modelled role inheritance and per-user conditional availability, which makes every course read a per-user cache key.
points.runs: Ran 336 k6 runs over 112 combinations of cache strategy, workload, Redis topology and concurrency up to 2,000 users, then tested the results with ANOVA and Tukey HSD.
points.result: Measured 53 to 72 req/s across all four strategies at every level, with CPU at 86% or above from 100 users, so the cost sat in Eloquent hydration and repeated context resolution.

points.billing: Built the seat-based subscription path on a Go (Gin, GORM) backend: the server holds the Midtrans charge and webhook, so a seat count moves only after the provider confirms payment.
points.proration: Prorated a mid-cycle upgrade by the daily price difference for the days left, and charged the full new price when a trial converted.
points.attendance: Built attendance that refuses a clock-in outside the office radius, containerised the stack with Docker, and deployed to Azure.
points.routes: Built the record screens for employees, leave, overtime and documents in Next.js, with TanStack Table grids and react-hook-form against a Go and PostgreSQL API.
points.map: Built the Leaflet map of attendance geofences and the Chart.js dashboards.
points.deploy: Built the frontend image in Docker and deployed it to Azure Container Apps from GitHub Actions.

points.redis: Built a Hono shortener where Redis absorbs click counters, so a hot link does not serialise on a PostgreSQL row lock.
points.limits: Capped shortening at 10 requests a minute per IP and redirects at 100 per IP and code, on Redis counters that survive a restart.
points.monorepo: Put rate limiting in Redis-backed middleware, kept the schema in one Drizzle package, and shipped the monorepo to a VPS.
points.htmx: Built the front end with HTMX and Alpine.js and no client-side router, so the page arrives rendered and the browser gets one small script.

points.astro: Built the site in Astro 7 with React islands and Tailwind 4, under a strict Content Security Policy with hashed inline styles and no third-party scripts.
points.og: Generated a preview image per post with satori at build time, so a shared link renders a card without a runtime service.

points.react: Built an ideas browser in React 19 and React Router 8 with React Compiler, TanStack Query and Tailwind 4.
points.url: Kept page, size, sort and search in the URL, restored scroll on back, and loaded the detail query before navigating, so a back press lands on the same list.
points.a11y: Ran Playwright with axe-core on every page, and recorded the one accepted brand contrast pair, so any other violation fails the suite.

points.tool: Aggregates JobStreet, Greenhouse and Kalibrr into one database, logs how each run ended, and marks closed listings.

points.prs: Merged three pull requests into meiro, an open-source Go YouTube Music client: a Flatpak Discord socket path, every artist in rich presence, and Firefox and Zen sign-in.
points.trace: Traced the cause of the rich presence retry loop on Flatpak Discord, and covered the new artist field with Go tests.

backend.label: Backend
backend.summary: Backend Engineer. Cut 8 to 12 days of manual entry a year for 200+ employees, and built a Go service that bills seats via Midtrans.

frontend.label: Frontend
frontend.summary: Frontend-focused full-stack developer. Carried most of the frontend on a five-person Next.js build, and wrote 549 of its 965 commits, including the table, form and map components the record screens reuse.

fullstack.label: Full-Stack
fullstack.summary: Full-stack engineer. Built an HRIS end to end, the Go service that bills seats through Midtrans and the screens HR uses for records, leave, overtime and attendance.
